changes.title: Coloured shadows
items: Shadows are coloured, not black: a campfire's throws a cool blue-violet, and runestones and soundsystems cast a soft shade of their own glow

changes.title: Scenery shadows
items: Temples, castles, ruins, set pieces, relics, runestones and soundsystems now cast shadows from your glow and the campfires, like the tree trunks

changes.title: Win pulse now
items: Clearing every area on the island wins the night straight away: two fast finale pulses race from where the wave's pulse is, one home and one on to the end of the ley line, fireworks at every stone they pass
